en: "Rare Shadows"{SAUT}Sometimes special enemies known as{SAUT}{f 0 1 2}Rare Shadows{f 0 1 0} will appear in the dungeons.
Rare Shadows may look like ordinary{SAUT}Shadows, but there is a difference!

If you attack them and they are resistant{SAUT}to that attack's affinity, they will perform{SAUT}a powerful counterattack against you!{SAUT}But if you can find a weakness and exploit{SAUT}it, you'll stand a much better chance.
Compared to an ordinary Team Convert,{SAUT}Quick Convert makes it easier to knock{SAUT}down Shadows.
